verses.original: מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֛ה וַיַּ֧עַל מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל אֶל־ הַבֹּכִ֑ים פ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וָאָבִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתִּי֙ לַאֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וָאֹמַ֕ר לֹֽא־ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ אָפֵ֧ר בְּרִיתִ֛י אִתְּכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh way·ya·‘al min- hag·gil·gāl ’el- hab·bō·ḵīm p̄ way·yō·mer ’a·‘ă·leh ’eṯ·ḵem mim·miṣ·ra·yim wā·’ā·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wā·’ō·mar lō- lə·‘ō·w·lām ’ā·p̄êr bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim and said I brought you up - out of Egypt and led - you into the land that I had promised to your fathers and I said I will never . . . break My covenant with you

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹֽא־ תִכְרְת֤וּ בְרִית֙ לְיֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הַזֹּ֔את הָאָ֣רֶץ תִּתֹּצ֑וּן מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹֽא־ שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם בְּקֹלִ֖י מַה־ זֹּ֥את עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem lō- ṯiḵ·rə·ṯū ḇə·rîṯ lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ tit·tō·ṣūn miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯê·hem wə·lō- šə·ma‘·tem bə·qō·lî mah- zōṯ ‘ă·śî·ṯem
verses.literal: and you are not to make a covenant with the people of this land but you shall tear down their altars Yet you have not obeyed My voice What is this you have done

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹֽא־ אֲגָרֵ֥שׁ אוֹתָ֖ם מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֤וּ לָכֶם֙ לְצִדִּ֔ים וֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם יִהְי֥וּ לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃ לָכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’ā·mar·tî lō- ’ă·ḡā·rêš ’ō·w·ṯām mip·pə·nê·ḵem wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem lə·ṣid·dîm wê·lō·hê·hem yih·yū lə·mō·w·qêš lā·ḵem
verses.literal: So now I tell you that I will not drive out [these people] - before you they will be [thorns] in your sides and their gods will be a snare to you

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ כְּדַבֵּ֞ר הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֣ים אֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָעָ֛ם אֶת־ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- kə·ḏab·bêr hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ’el- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·‘ām ’eṯ- way·yiś·’ū qō·w·lām way·yiḇ·kū
verses.literal: - When the angel of the LORD - had spoken these words to all the Israelites . . . the people - lifted up their voices and wept

verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם־ הַה֖וּא הַמָּק֥וֹם בֹּכִ֑ים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ שָׁ֖ם לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū šêm- ha·hū ham·mā·qō·wm bō·ḵîm way·yiz·bə·ḥū- šām Yah·weh
verses.literal: So they called . . . that place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the LORD

verses.original: יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶת־ וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח הָעָ֑ם בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ אִ֥ישׁ לְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- way·šal·laḥ hā·‘ām ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·lə·ḵū lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’îš lə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: After Joshua had dismissed the people the Israelites . . . went out to take possession of - the land each to his own inheritance

verses.original: הָעָם֙ אֶת־ וַיַּעַבְד֤וּ יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֹ֣ל׀ יְמֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשׁ֔וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָא֗וּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַגָּד֔וֹל מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָה֙ עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām ’eṯ- way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū Yah·weh kōl yə·mê yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·ḵōl yə·mê haz·zə·qê·nîm ’ă·šer he·’ĕ·rî·ḵū yā·mîm ’a·ḥă·rê yə·hō·wō·šū·a‘ ’ă·šer rā·’ū ’êṯ kāl- hag·gā·ḏō·wl ma·‘ă·śêh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And the people - served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua [and] - of the elders who outlived . . . . . . [him] who had seen - all the great works that the LORD had done for Israel

verses.original: יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּ֛מָת בֶּן־ שָׁנִֽים׃ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh way·yā·māṯ ben- šā·nîm mê·’āh wā·‘e·śer
verses.literal: And Joshua son of Nun the servant of the LORD died at the age . . . of 110 . . .

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אוֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔וֹ בְּתִמְנַת־ חֶ֖רֶס בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְהַר־ גָּֽעַשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·w·ṯōw biḡ·ḇūl na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw bə·ṯim·naṯ- ḥe·res bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim miṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·wn lə·har- gā·‘aš
verses.literal: They buried him in the land of his inheritance vvv at Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash

verses.original: אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם כָּל־ הַדּ֣וֹר הַה֔וּא וְגַם֙ נֶאֶסְפ֖וּ אֶל־ אֲבוֹתָ֑יו אַחֵ֜ר דּ֨וֹר וַיָּקָם֩ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ יָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגַם֙ אֶת־ הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê·hem kāl- had·dō·wr ha·hū wə·ḡam ne·’es·p̄ū ’el- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāw ’a·ḥêr dō·wr way·yā·qām ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ham·ma·‘ă·śeh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: After that whole generation - had also been gathered to their fathers another generation rose up who did not know - the LORD or - the works that He had done for Israel

verses.original: בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- way·ya·‘ă·śū hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: And the Israelites . . . - did evil in the sight of the LORD and served - the Baals

verses.original: וַיַּעַזְב֞וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֗ם הַמּוֹצִ֣יא אוֹתָם֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַיֵּלְכ֞וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ אֲחֵרִ֗ים מֵאֱלֹהֵ֤י אֱלֹהִ֣ים הָֽעַמִּים֙ סְבִיב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיַּכְעִ֖סוּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘az·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ham·mō·w·ṣî ’ō·w·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·yê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḥê·rîm mê·’ĕ·lō·hê ’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·‘am·mîm sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem ’ă·šer way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lā·hem way·yaḵ·‘i·sū ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus they forsook - the LORD the God of their fathers who had brought them - out of the land of Egypt and they followed after various . . . gods of the peoples around them - They bowed down to them and provoked - the LORD {to anger}

verses.original: וַיַּעַזְב֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ לַבַּ֖עַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘az·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū lab·ba·‘al wə·lā·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: for they forsook - Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths

verses.original: אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ וַיִּֽחַר־ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיִּתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַד־ שֹׁסִ֔ים וַיָּשֹׁ֖סּוּ אוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵ֞ם בְּיַ֤ד אֽוֹיְבֵיהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב יָכְל֣וּ וְלֹֽא־ ע֔וֹד לַעֲמֹ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י אוֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ Yah·weh way·yi·ḥar- bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yit·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ- šō·sîm way·yā·šōs·sū ’ō·w·ṯām way·yim·kə·rêm bə·yaḏ ’ō·wy·ḇê·hem mis·sā·ḇîḇ yā·ḵə·lū wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ la·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê ’ō·wy·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He delivered them into the hands vvv of those who plundered them He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around whom they were no longer able to resist . . . -

verses.original: בְּכֹ֣ל׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָצְא֗וּ יַד־ יְהוָה֙ הָיְתָה־ בָּ֣ם לְרָעָ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְכַאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֥צֶר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yā·ṣə·’ū yaḏ- Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh- bām lə·rā·‘āh ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh wə·ḵa·’ă·šer dib·ber niš·ba‘ Yah·weh lā·hem way·yê·ṣer lā·hem mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Wherever - [Israel] marched out the hand of the LORD was against them to bring calamity just as He - vvv had sworn . . . to them So they were greatly distressed . . . . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּ֥קֶם שֹֽׁפְטִ֑ים וַיּ֣וֹשִׁיע֔וּם מִיַּ֖ד שֹׁסֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yā·qem šō·p̄ə·ṭîm way·yō·wō·šî·‘ūm mî·yaḏ šō·sê·hem
verses.literal: Then the LORD raised up judges who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ אֶל־ שֹֽׁפְטֵיהֶם֙ כִּ֣י זָנ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֱלֹהִ֣ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם מַהֵ֗ר סָ֣רוּ מִן־ הַדֶּ֜רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲבוֹתָ֛ם הָלְכ֧וּ לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ יְהוָ֖ה מִצְוֺת־ לֹא־ עָ֥שׂוּ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam lō šā·mê·‘ū ’el- šō·p̄ə·ṭê·hem kî zā·nū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lā·hem ma·hêr sā·rū min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām hā·lə·ḵū liš·mō·a‘ Yah·weh miṣ·wōṯ- lō- ‘ā·śū ḵên
verses.literal: [Israel,] however did not listen to their judges Instead they prostituted themselves with other gods and bowed down to them They quickly turned from the way - of their fathers who had walked in obedience to the LORD’s commandments they did not do as their fathers [had done] . . .

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה׀ הֵקִ֨ים שֹֽׁפְטִים֒ לָהֶם֮ יְהוָה֙ וְהָיָ֤ה עִם־ הַשֹּׁפֵ֔ט וְהֽוֹשִׁיעָם֙ מִיַּ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם הַשּׁוֹפֵ֑ט כִּֽי־ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוָה֙ יִנָּחֵ֤ם מִנַּֽאֲקָתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֥י לֹחֲצֵיהֶ֖ם וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- Yah·weh hê·qîm šō·p̄ə·ṭîm lā·hem Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh ‘im- haš·šō·p̄êṭ wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ām mî·yaḏ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem haš·šō·w·p̄êṭ kî- kōl yə·mê Yah·weh yin·nā·ḥêm min·na·’ă·qā·ṯām mip·pə·nê lō·ḥă·ṣê·hem wə·ḏō·ḥă·qê·hem
verses.literal: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for the Israelites [He] was with that judge and saved them from the hands of their enemies while the judge . . . was still alive . . . for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppressed them and afflicted them

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַשּׁוֹפֵ֗ט יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ בְּמ֣וֹת וְהִשְׁחִ֣יתוּ מֵֽאֲבוֹתָ֔ם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעָבְדָ֖ם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם לֹ֤א הִפִּ֙ילוּ֙ מִמַּ֣עַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם הַקָּשָֽׁה׃ וּמִדַּרְכָּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh haš·šō·w·p̄êṭ yā·šu·ḇū bə·mō·wṯ wə·hiš·ḥî·ṯū mê·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏām ū·lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ lā·hem lō hip·pî·lū mim·ma·‘al·lê·hem haq·qā·šāh ū·mid·dar·kām
verses.literal: But when the judge . . . died the Israelites became even more corrupt than their fathers going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them They would not give up their evil practices and stubborn ways

verses.original: אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּֽחַר־ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַזֶּ֗ה אֶת־ הַגּ֣וֹי עָבְר֜וּ בְּרִיתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ לְקוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ Yah·weh way·yi·ḥar- bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ya·‘an ’ă·šer haz·zeh ’eṯ- hag·gō·w ‘ā·ḇə·rū bə·rî·ṯî ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū lə·qō·w·lî
verses.literal: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He said Because - this - nation has transgressed the covenant - I laid down - for their fathers and has not heeded My voice

verses.original: גַּם־ אֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א אוֹסִ֔יף לְהוֹרִ֥ישׁ מִן־ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם אִ֖ישׁ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ עָזַ֥ב וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ă·nî lō ’ō·w·sîp̄ lə·hō·w·rîš min- mip·pə·nê·hem ’îš hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ‘ā·zaḇ way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: - I will no longer drive out before them . . . any of the nations - Joshua left when he died

verses.original: לְמַ֛עַן נַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖ם אֶת־ אִם־ לֹֽא׃ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֵם֩ אֶת־ הֲשֹׁמְרִ֣ים דֶּ֨רֶךְ יְהוָ֜ה לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר שָׁמְר֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an nas·sō·wṯ bām ’eṯ- ’im- lō yiś·rā·’êl hêm ’eṯ- hă·šō·mə·rîm de·reḵ Yah·weh lā·le·ḵeṯ bām ka·’ă·šer šā·mə·rū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: In this way I will test - whether . . . Israel - - will keep the way of the LORD by walking in it as . . . their fathers did

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַגּוֹיִ֣ם וַיַּנַּ֤ח לְבִלְתִּ֥י הוֹרִישָׁ֖ם מַהֵ֑ר וְלֹ֥א נְתָנָ֖ם בְּיַד־ יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- hā·’êl·leh hag·gō·w·yim way·yan·naḥ lə·ḇil·tî hō·w·rî·šām ma·hêr wə·lō nə·ṯā·nām bə·yaḏ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘
verses.literal: That is why the LORD - had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately - by delivering them into the hand of Joshua
